theorem.setup: AFTER ALL SELECTED ADMISSIBLE QUERIES, LET THE FINITE WORLD SUPERDOMAIN BE PARTITIONED INTO OBSERVATIONAL EQUIVALENCE CELLS E_j. CHOOSE ONE BRAIN-OWNED POLICY p_j FOR EACH CELL.
theorem.policy_conflict_escape: H = UNION_OVER_j {w IN E_j : p_j IS NOT TERMINALLY ADEQUATE IN w}.
theorem.target_support: LET U BE THE ACTUAL USEFUL TARGET SUPPORT INSIDE THE DECLARED SOUND SUPERDOMAIN.
theorem.statement: THE QUERY-PLUS-POLICY ROUTE IS SUFFICIENT FOR ZERO EXTRA SEMANTIC MESSAGE ON THE ACTUAL TARGET SUPPORT IFF U INTERSECTION H IS EMPTY.
proof: IF U INTERSECTION H IS EMPTY, EVERY TARGET WORLD IN EACH CELL LIES IN THE ADEQUACY SET OF THAT CELL'S CHOSEN POLICY, SO QUERY RESULTS PLUS THE CELL POLICY SUFFICE WITHOUT EXACT TARGET IDENTITY.
IF SOME TARGET WORLD LIES IN H, THE CHOSEN POLICY IS NOT ADEQUATE THERE, SO THAT QUERY/POLICY ROUTE CANNOT CERTIFY THE TARGET SUPPORT.
THEREFORE EXTERNAL TARGET INFORMATION NEED ONLY EXCLUDE H; IT NEED NOT IDENTIFY WHICH SAFE WORLD IN E_j IS ACTUAL.
theorem.optimization: SELECT THE QUERY TREE AND PER-CELL POLICY ASSIGNMENT THAT MINIMIZE THE COST OF PROVING TARGET NONOCCUPANCY OF H SUBJECT TO RESOURCE DEADLINE AND OWNERSHIP CONSTRAINTS. MINIMUM CARDINALITY H IS ONE SIMPLE SURROGATE, NOT A CLAIMED UNIVERSAL EVIDENCE-COST OPTIMUM.

combined_escape_interpretation.prior_A_B_escape: TARGET INFORMATION IS LOAD-BEARING ONLY IN THE CURRENT BRAIN-UNDOMINATED REGION.
combined_escape_interpretation.new_semantic_refinement: INSIDE THE SHARED FIVE-ROLE SEMANTIC FRONTIER, THE LOAD-BEARING TARGET REGION SHRINKS FURTHER TO THE POLICY-CONFLICT EXCLUSION SET H AFTER THE BEST SOUND QUERIES AND OWNED-POLICY ASSIGNMENT.
scheduler_effect: DO_NOT ASK FOR EXACT OPUS TARGET IDENTITY WHEN AN EXCLUSION CERTIFICATE FOR H IS ENOUGH.
DO_NOT QUERY OPUS ABOUT WORLDS ALREADY COVERED BY THE CHOSEN ADEQUATE POLICY IN THEIR OBSERVATIONAL CELL.
FIRST TRY TO MAKE H EMPTY BY BETTER ADMISSIBLE QUERIES OR A BETTER OWNED POLICY.
IF H REMAINS NONEMPTY, SEARCH FOR THE CHEAPEST SOUND STRUCTURAL OR TARGET-RELATIVE CERTIFICATE THAT OPUS OCCUPIES NONE OF H.
DIRECT COMPARATOR OUTPUTS ARE LAST RESORT AND SHOULD BE REQUESTED ONLY TO RESOLVE OCCUPANCY OF THE SURVIVING H.

finite_examples: TWO OBSERVATIONALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE WORLDS REQUIRING DIFFERENT POLICIES HAVE ONE BIT OF FULL-MODEL SEMANTIC RESIDUAL, BUT IF TARGET SUPPORT IS CERTIFIED TO CONTAIN ONLY ONE WORLD, ZERO EXTRA SEMANTIC MESSAGE IS NEEDED; ONLY EXCLUSION OF THE OTHER WORLD IS LOAD-BEARING.
IF A QUERY SEPARATES THOSE TWO WORLDS, H CAN BE EMPTY WITH ONE POLICY PER RESULT CELL AND NO TARGET-IDENTITY INFORMATION.
falsifiers: THE DECLARED TARGET SUPPORT U IS NOT SOUNDLY CONTAINED IN THE WORLD SUPERDOMAIN.
